prerequisites: Existing uv and Git; source-specific compiler/system libraries and backend prerequisites from nstack show P307. This recipe selects CPU/basic package only; it installs no weights, provider extras, device driver, daemon or global tool. Build/submodule incompatibility fails closed.
lock_resolution: Fetch and check out only this exact commit in a private owned build prefix. Resolve explicit source build-system requirements to a hash lock, build one wheel without build isolation, verify its distribution metadata, resolve runtime dependencies to a second hash lock, sync with required hashes. Retain source/wheel/interpreter/uv identity and all environment file hashes. Repeat commissioning verifies the existing lock without resolving upgrades.
invoke: From a bounded project: nstack run P307 python -- /absolute/project/script.py [arguments]. Use only the registered package API, actual task inputs and current project permissions.
check: nstack check P307 python (actual import and distribution identity only). Then execute the distinct output, negative control and independent comparison from the component acceptance checks; import success is not domain acceptance.
deactivate: Each script exits normally; stop only a task-owned service started by that script after reconciling effects. nstack remove-runtime P307 python quarantines the exact owned environment and lock into private recovery. No global registration is created.
